body:
Code Review by Qodo


1. Contact erasure can report false success 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>requestDeletion posts to an unimplemented /api/lgpd-delete-radar-data route and sets isDeleted
>from the HTTP status alone. The deployment rewrites unmatched paths to the app entrypoint, so a
>successful fallback response can be presented as completed erasure even though no deletion ran.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The deletion hook calls a route that has no implementation and treats any successful HTTP response as proof of erasure. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useLGPDRetention.ts[26-40] >- vercel.json[25-29] >## Recommended Fix >Implement an authenticated, authorized server-side deletion operation for the relevant contact data. Call that operation through the application's supported API path and set `isDeleted` only after validating its explicit deletion result. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4255e25c-0c07-4b3a-bcf2-c908eca1fa43?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4255e25c-0c07-4b3a-bcf2-c908eca1fa43)
2. Both suggestion checks lack a server 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>useFactChecker and useProhibitedPromises post to /api routes for which this repository
>supplies no handlers. When either check is invoked, it cannot obtain a fact-check or
>prohibited-promise result; the existing suggestion service is instead invoked as a Supabase Edge
>Function.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The two new checks call routes that are not implemented by the application. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useFactChecker.ts[35-48] >- src/hooks/copilot/useProhibitedPromises.ts[27-40] >## Recommended Fix >Implement both server-side checks and invoke them using the application's deployed endpoint convention, or connect the hooks to existing server-side checks with verified request and response contracts. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/3651bb51-998a-430d-96fa-3c8e5f850431?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/3651bb51-998a-430d-96fa-3c8e5f850431)
3. Failed checks leave suggestions marked safe 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>useFactChecker and useProhibitedPromises preserve the previous isSafe value when their
>requests fail, which is true on initialization. A network, HTTP, or response-parsing failure
>therefore leaves a suggestion appearing cleared without either check completing; the promise check
>also exposes no error to its caller.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Both safety hooks can retain a safe result after a failed check, including their initially safe state. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useFactChecker.ts[28-57] >- src/hooks/copilot/useProhibitedPromises.ts[21-49] >## Recommended Fix >Represent unchecked, pending, failed, safe, and violating results distinctly. Clear any prior approval when starting a check, expose failures to callers, and permit display only after the current suggestion receives a successful safe result. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/87f938e7-7097-4ee1-9880-2c19a78bd898?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/87f938e7-7097-4ee1-9880-2c19a78bd898)
4. Unchecked suggestions still reach sellers 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>The new fact and promise hooks are exported but are not called between ai-suggest-reply returning
>suggestions and AISuggestions displaying them. Numeric claims and prohibited promises therefore
>reach the existing selection action without either proposed pre-display check.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The new suggestion checks are exported but not used by the live suggestion flow. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/index.ts[123-128] >- src/components/inbox/AISuggestions.tsx[101-146] >- src/components/inbox/AISuggestions.tsx[217-245] >## Recommended Fix >Run the checks for each returned suggestion before adding it to the rendered list. Render and allow selection only for suggestions whose current checks have completed successfully and passed. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/548704fa-87cd-4df9-aefc-d9a5fc26d636?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/548704fa-87cd-4df9-aefc-d9a5fc26d636)
5. Sensitive text still reaches the model 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>useSensitiveDataMasker and usePromptInjectionGuard are only exported, not applied to the
>messages submitted by the existing AI callers. Those callers continue sending raw conversation
>content, so the new masking and injection decisions do not run before model submission.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The privacy and injection hooks do not participate in existing model requests. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/index.ts[130-134] >- src/components/inbox/AISuggestions.tsx[98-113] >- src/components/inbox/AIConversationAssistant.tsx[105-120] >## Recommended Fix >Apply sensitive-data handling and untrusted-message checks at the shared server-side model-submission boundary, covering every AI caller. Wire any client-side warning into the relevant callers without relying on it as the sole protection. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/104b3d62-5bdd-443a-8824-347e9b1e8429?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/104b3d62-5bdd-443a-8824-347e9b1e8429)
6. The new ownership check gates no data 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>useCopilotAuthorization computes a client-side result but is not used by the existing suggestion
>or analysis request paths. Those paths continue to request their data without consulting
>conversation assignment, so adding this hook does not enforce the stated seller restriction.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The new ownership result is unused by the request paths it is intended to restrict. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useCopilotAuthorization.ts[19-39] >- src/components/inbox/AISuggestions.tsx[101-119] >- src/hooks/chat/useLatestAnalysis.ts[18-42] >## Recommended Fix >Enforce assignment and verified supervisor role in the server-side data and suggestion endpoints before returning insights. Use the hook for UI behavior only, deriving its inputs from trusted application state. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/8c1dcc83-c7a5-44ca-a83e-b7e2ae5325ad?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/8c1dcc83-c7a5-44ca-a83e-b7e2ae5325ad)
7. Emergency stop leaves AI requests active 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>useEmergencyStop only derives isStopped from a supplied boolean and calls an optional onStop;
>no existing AI request path consumes that result. Disabling the intended flag through this new
>interface therefore does not prevent the suggestion or supervisor Copilot paths from invoking their
>AI services.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The new emergency-stop state is not consumed where AI processing starts. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useEmergencyStop.ts[20-27] >- src/components/inbox/AISuggestions.tsx[101-119] >- src/components/admin/SupervisorCopilot.tsx[83-105] >## Recommended Fix >Connect the master flag and stop action to the deployed flag service, then enforce the disabled state at the server-side AI entry points. Also prevent affected UI callers from initiating requests while the stop is active. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/a93b0580-afa4-45a9-abae-550529f4c1bd?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/a93b0580-afa4-45a9-abae-550529f4c1bd)

View medium (6)
8. Suggestion cards omit the AI warning 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>AITransparencyBadge is introduced and exported without being mounted in the existing suggestion
>cards. Sellers can still see and select generated responses in AISuggestions and AIResponseCard
>without the promised review-before-sending notice.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Exporting the new badge does not add it to cards sellers currently use. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/components/copilot/index.ts[54-56] >- src/components/inbox/AISuggestions.tsx[217-245] >- src/components/inbox/ai-tools/AIResponseCard.tsx[36-91] >## Recommended Fix >Mount the transparency notice in each existing AI suggestion card before its selection or use action, using valid markup for the card's interactive container. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4860f595-203c-476e-b3d7-8d6a9b34ef98?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/4860f595-203c-476e-b3d7-8d6a9b34ef98)
9. Different prices can pass the bias check 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>checkPair approves suggestions whenever whole-text token overlap reaches 0.3, without comparing
>prices or other consequential terms. For otherwise identical demographic test contexts, changing
>only a name and R$100 to R$200 can still leave enough shared words to return true.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Whole-text similarity can approve demographic-dependent changes to prices or treatment. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useBiasGuard.ts[26-31] >- src/hooks/copilot/useBiasGuard.ts[48-62] >## Recommended Fix >Compare structured price, terms, and treatment outputs for paired inputs that differ only in the demographic field. Do not use a low whole-text similarity threshold as the approval criterion for those fields. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/9fba733f-0590-4335-9c52-7ca06e1fd765?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/9fba733f-0590-4335-9c52-7ca06e1fd765)
10. A common English injection passes 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>The ignore pattern accepts all previous but then requires a Portuguese spelling of “instruções.”
>A message saying “ignore all previous instructions” matches none of the listed patterns and is
>returned as safe.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The English alternative in the injection pattern still requires a Portuguese word for instructions. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/usePromptInjectionGuard.ts[13-26] >- src/hooks/copilot/usePromptInjectionGuard.ts[34-42] >## Recommended Fix >Add a pattern for common English override phrases such as `ignore all previous instructions`, with focused positive and negative tests. Keep the heuristic supplemental to server-side separation of untrusted content from instructions. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/5c07a994-164e-4c54-864a-93b054a6a249?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/5c07a994-164e-4c54-864a-93b054a6a249)
11. Bank details escape sensitive detection 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>hasSensitiveData tests CPF, CNPJ, and card patterns but omits BANK_BRANCH_RE, despite mask
>using it. For example, Agência: 1234 is altered by mask but reported as containing no sensitive
>data by the companion detector.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The sensitive-data detector omits bank branches that the masking function handles. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useSensitiveDataMasker.ts[12-19] >- src/hooks/copilot/useSensitiveDataMasker.ts[30-46] >## Recommended Fix >Include bank-branch detection in `hasSensitiveData`, and test that each category changed by `mask` is also detected. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/cfedde8a-447a-4964-ba1a-55a2da38eb03?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/cfedde8a-447a-4964-ba1a-55a2da38eb03)
12. An empty review approves the pilot 🐞
>
>Description >
> >
>SecurityReviewPanel calculates approval with items.every(...), which is true for an empty array.
>Supplying no security checks therefore displays “OK para piloto” even though none of the stated
>review items has passed.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >An empty checklist satisfies the panel's all-pass expression and receives the pilot approval label. >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/components/copilot/SecurityReviewPanel.tsx[26-38] >## Recommended Fix >Require a nonempty checklist containing the required critical review categories before showing approval. Display an incomplete state when no items or required checks are supplied. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/65738df1-a0bc-43ec-8357-d2268e7151ac?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/65738df1-a0bc-43ec-8357-d2268e7151ac)
13. New guardrail filenames break convention 📜
>
>Description >
> >
>The new useFactChecker.ts file, like the other new guardrail hooks and components, uses camelCase
>or PascalCase rather than the skill’s prescribed snake_case filenames. The new barrels reference
>those paths, so renaming the files to follow the convention also requires updating their exports.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >New guardrail hook and component filenames do not follow the repository skill’s snake_case naming convention. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/hooks/copilot/useFactChecker.ts[1-1] >- src/hooks/copilot/index.ts[123-146] >- src/components/copilot/index.ts[54-58] > >## Recommended Fix >Rename the new guardrail hook and component files to snake_case, then update their barrel exports and any other references to the renamed paths. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/44a7101f-792b-42f5-8ec8-9ab21766863a?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/44a7101f-792b-42f5-8ec8-9ab21766863a)

performed_via_github_app.description:
### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
